findings.failure_path: A pull request can delete or rewrite historical specs plans/evidence, either alone or alongside an otherwise valid ledger-bound change. `:(exclude)specs` removes all those paths from the frozen candidate, and the new test requires an arbitrary specs evidence change to return `no reviewed-path change`, so the gate passes while committed review history is corrupted.
findings.smallest_fix: Do not exclude the whole specs tree. Narrow the candidate exclusion to the exact self-referential ledger artifacts required for the current round, and bind or independently reject modifications to all other specs content; add regression cases for deleting and rewriting prior plans/evidence.

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: The widened scope intentionally refuses valid non-spec documentation changes such as README-only work, but still excludes the entire specs tree. Consequently destructive or unrelated changes to plans and historical review evidence can ride through without moving the candidate; the added evidence-only test explicitly preserves this bypass.

Containment is incomplete: the exclusion is directory-wide rather than limited to the self-referential ledger artifact, so the shared gate does not protect the integrity of other tracked review records under specs.
